name: Radical Writes Content Repurposer
author: raadrouhan

sections.description:
Most content creators write one post and stop there.

They’re leaving 80% of their reach on the table.

Radical Writes Content Repurposer is a minimalist WordPress plugin for solo founders, strategists, and content architects who want to build long-term digital assets — not chase daily output volume.

Write once. Distribute everywhere.

What It Does

Radical Writes Content Repurposer adds a sidebar panel directly into your Gutenberg editor. With one click, it takes your blog post and generates platform-ready content for:

  • LinkedIn — A hook-driven post with strategic insight and no corporate fluff
  • X (Twitter) Thread — 5-8 punchy tweets built around your core idea
  • Newsletter Section — A reader-first section ready to paste into Beehiiv, Substack, or Mailchimp

The Philosophy

This plugin is built on one idea: content should compound like an asset, not evaporate like a post.

Every output follows the Problem-Agitation-Solution and The Bridge frameworks. No AI-isms. No filler. One thought per line.

Tone Presets

Choose how you want to sound:

  • Helpful Architect — Confident, specific, advisor-level
  • Radical Truth-Teller — Direct, honest, no hedging
  • Technical Guide — Precise, structured, builder-focused

BYOK Model (Bring Your Own Key)

Radical Writes Content Repurposer does not charge you for AI usage. You connect your own API key from:

  • Google Gemini (free tier available)
  • Anthropic Claude
  • OpenAI

Your key is encrypted using AES-256-CBC before being stored. The raw key never touches the database.

Who This Is For

  • Solo founders building a personal brand
  • Content strategists who write long-form and need distribution
  • Agency owners who want to repurpose client content faster
  • Anyone tired of rewriting the same idea five times manually

Privacy

Radical Writes Content Repurposer sends your post content to the AI provider you choose (Google, Anthropic, or OpenAI) for processing. No data is sent to the plugin author. Review the privacy policy of your chosen AI provider before use.

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party AI APIs to generate repurposed content.
Your blog post text is sent to the provider you select only when you click
“Generate Distribution Kit”. No data is sent automatically or without
your explicit action. No data is sent to the plugin author.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the architect-core folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Radical Writes → The Vault in your admin menu
  4. Add your API key from Google Gemini, Anthropic, or OpenAI
  5. Open any post in the Gutenberg editor
  6. Look for the gold square button in the top-right toolbar of the Gutenberg editor to open The Amplifier sidebar. Alternatively, find it in the three-dot menu under Panels.
  7. Select your tone, choose your output formats, and hit Generate Distribution Kit
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes. Radical Writes Content Repurposer is completely free. You only pay for your own API usage directly to your chosen AI provider. Google Gemini offers a free tier that works well for testing and light use.

Which AI provider should I use?

Start with Google Gemini — it has a free tier at aistudio.google.com. Create an account, generate an API key, and paste it in The Vault. No credit card required for the free tier.

Is my API key safe?

Yes. Your key is encrypted using AES-256-CBC encryption tied to your WordPress site’s unique AUTH_KEY before being saved to the database. The raw key is never stored. Only WordPress admins can access The Vault page.

Does deactivating the plugin delete my keys?

No. Deactivating only clears temporary cache data. Your API keys stay safe until you manually delete the plugin.

What is the BYOK model?

BYOK stands for Bring Your Own Key. You connect your own API account from Google, Anthropic, or OpenAI. This means your API costs go directly to the provider — not through us. You stay in full control of your usage and billing.

Will this work with page builders like Elementor or Divi?

Radical Writes Content Repurposer works inside the native WordPress Gutenberg block editor only. It does not currently support classic editor or third-party page builders.

How long should my post be for best results?

At least 300 words. The plugin works best with posts between 500-2000 words. Very short posts may produce thin output. Very long posts (5000+ words) will be intelligently truncated to the most relevant sections.

Can I edit the generated content?

Yes. Every output appears in an editable text area inside the sidebar. Edit directly before copying.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Module A: The Vault — encrypted API key storage (Google Gemini, Anthropic, OpenAI)
  • Module B: The Amplifier — Gutenberg sidebar with one-click content repurposing
  • Three tone presets: Helpful Architect, Radical Truth-Teller, Technical Guide
  • Three output formats: LinkedIn, X Thread, Newsletter
  • BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model — zero platform API costs
